none: PAS LVPL-E08676: Silver Roman finger ring fragment, TOT ring. 2007-T387.
contea di ritrovamento: Nottinghamshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

CURATOR'S REPORT. Description of Object. Roman silver ring of 'keeled' type; just less than half of the hoop is missing. The circular profile hoop is square in section; the ring has flat triangular shoulders decorated with incised spirals. The circular bezel is inscribed 'TOT' inside a border of punched dots. Date: 3rd century AD. Discussion. 'TOT' is thought to be a reference to the god…
